title: Segub
summary: Raleigh names Segub in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Segub, youngest sonne of Chel of Bethel, lost when his father built the gates of Iericho. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XII, §. I, sig. 255b
